name: JavaScript Beautifier
summary: Beautify messy JavaScript with indentation — locally in your browser.
description: Paste minified or messy JavaScript and get a readable, indented result. Preserves strings, comments, and regex literals. Optional minify-into-input. Lightweight heuristic formatter — not Prettier.

faqs.question: Is this Prettier?
faqs.answer: No. It is a lightweight brace/semicolon-aware beautifier that keeps strings and comments intact. Complex edge cases may differ from Prettier.

faqs.question: Can I minify?
faqs.answer: Use “Minify into input” here, or open the dedicated JavaScript Minifier for comment stripping and size stats.

faqs.question: TypeScript / JSX?
faqs.answer: Plain JS works best. JSX/TS syntax may format imperfectly because this is not a full language parser.

faqs.question: Is my code uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Formatting runs entirely in your browser.
